comment: The RST ALL button and the RST ALL input are summed at Bgates.cpp:235-239 and then taken as one rising edge, so pressing the button while the input is already high does nothing. The per-row clock normalling at :259-262 chains downwards, so one cable in the first CLK jack clocks all eight rows.
